title: Easy Chicken Cordon Bleu
reject_reason: Same chicken cordon bleu flavor identity (ham + swiss + dijon) as live chicken-cordon-bleu-casserole; catalog already carries both chicken and turkey cordon-bleu casseroles, so the cutlet format is a format variant of an already-saturated dinner (3 of 4 axes).
